tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently purchased a new coffeemaker for your dorm room from an online store, and you are satisfied with its performance in general. However, you are having one issue with the product that is a problem for you. You need to contact customer service to report the issue and request a resolution. Write an email to customer service.
bullets: Mention your satisfaction with the appliance's performance in general.
Describe the issue you are having with the product.
tasks.subject: Issue with coffeemaker
